verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a first-party Card Viewer SDK that embeds sensitive card data in your UI through iframes, so PCI-scoped data never flows through your servers or reaches page scripts. Its PCI page says customers who handle sensitive data on their own servers must be fully PCI compliant, and recommends the SDKs to reduce that burden. missing for 10: explicit vendor statement on which SAQ level applies (e.g. SAQ A vs D), explicit mention of PAN and CVV fields, documentation of the reveal/authorization token flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
